description: Conduct an enterprise risk assessment across strategic, operational, financial, compliance, and reputational categories.

steps.description: Identify risks across strategic, operational, financial, compliance, and reputational categories.

inputs.name: organization-context
inputs.desc: Description of the organization, industry, and scope

inputs.name: existing-risk-data
inputs.desc: Prior risk assessments or incident logs

outputs.name: risk-register-draft
outputs.desc: Initial list of identified risks by category

outputs.name: risk-sources
outputs.desc: Sources and evidence for each risk

process: Review the organization structure, strategy, and operating environment.
Identify risks in each category through interviews, workshops, and data review.
Document each risk with a description, category, and source.
Compile the draft risk register.

steps.description: Assess likelihood and impact for each identified risk and calculate risk scores.

inputs.name: risk-sources
inputs.desc: Sources and evidence for each risk

outputs.name: scored-risk-register
outputs.desc: Risk register with likelihood, impact, and risk scores

outputs.name: risk-heat-map
outputs.desc: Visual heat map plotting risks by likelihood and impact

process: Define the likelihood and impact scales (1-5 or qualitative).
Score each risk for likelihood and impact using available data and expert judgment.
Calculate the composite risk score for each entry.
Plot risks on the heat map.

steps.description: Define risk appetite and tolerance thresholds for the organization.

outputs.name: risk-appetite-statement
outputs.desc: Documented risk appetite and tolerance by category

outputs.name: threshold-criteria
outputs.desc: Criteria for acceptable, tolerable, and unacceptable risk levels

process: Review the scored risks with leadership.
Define the appetite (how much risk the organization is willing to accept) per category.
Set tolerance thresholds that trigger escalation or action.
Document the risk appetite statement.

steps.description: Assign risk owners and define mitigation responsibilities.

outputs.name: risk-ownership-matrix
outputs.desc: Matrix mapping each risk to an owner and mitigation plan

outputs.name: risk-assessment-report
outputs.desc: Final enterprise risk assessment report

process: Assign an owner to each risk based on functional responsibility.
Define the mitigation strategy (accept, mitigate, transfer, avoid) for each risk.
Set review cadence and reporting requirements.
Compile the final risk assessment report.

description: Manage Sarbanes-Oxley compliance from control identification through external audit preparation.

steps.description: Identify in-scope processes and controls for SOX compliance.

outputs.name: in-scope-processes
outputs.desc: Processes and accounts in scope for SOX

outputs.name: control-inventory
outputs.desc: Inventory of controls mapped to each process

process: Identify significant accounts and disclosures.
Map the processes that feed into those accounts.
Identify the key controls within each process.
Document the scope and control inventory.

steps.description: Document control descriptions, objectives, and testing procedures.

outputs.name: control-documentation
outputs.desc: Documented control descriptions with objectives and procedures

outputs.name: testing-plan
outputs.desc: Testing procedures and sample sizes for each control

process: Write the control description for each key control.
Define the control objective and what could go wrong.
Design the testing procedure (inquiry, observation, inspection, reperformance).
Set sample sizes based on control frequency.

steps.description: Test controls for design and operating effectiveness.

outputs.name: test-results
outputs.desc: Results of design and operating effectiveness tests

outputs.name: deficiency-list
outputs.desc: List of control deficiencies identified

process: Test design effectiveness by evaluating whether the control is designed to prevent or detect the risk.
Test operating effectiveness by selecting samples and executing the testing procedure.
Document each test result with evidence.
Classify deficiencies (deficiency, significant deficiency, material weakness).

steps.description: Remediate deficiencies and prepare for the external audit.

outputs.name: remediation-plan
outputs.desc: Plan to address each deficiency with timelines

outputs.name: sox-compliance-report
outputs.desc: Final SOX compliance report for audit readiness

process: Develop a remediation action for each deficiency.
Assign owners and deadlines for each remediation.
Retest remediated controls to confirm effectiveness.
Compile the SOX compliance report for the external auditor.

description: Run anti-money-laundering and know-your-customer checks for new and existing customers.

steps.description: Collect customer identification documents and verify completeness.

inputs.name: customer-information
inputs.desc: Name, address, date of birth, and entity type

inputs.name: jurisdiction
inputs.desc: Country or region for regulatory requirements

outputs.name: identity-documents
outputs.desc: Collected identification documents

outputs.name: document-checklist
outputs.desc: Checklist of required vs received documents

process: Determine required documents based on customer type and jurisdiction.
Collect government-issued ID, proof of address, and entity documents.
Verify document completeness against the checklist.
Flag missing or expired documents for follow-up.

steps.description: Verify customer identity against databases and screen against sanctions and PEP lists.

outputs.name: verification-result
outputs.desc: Identity verification outcome (pass, fail, manual review)

outputs.name: screening-hits
outputs.desc: Any matches against sanctions, PEP, or adverse media lists

process: Run identity verification against government and commercial databases.
Screen the customer name and aliases against OFAC, EU, and UN sanctions lists.
Screen against politically exposed persons (PEP) databases.
Check for adverse media related to financial crime.

steps.description: Assess the customer risk rating based on identity, geography, and transaction profile.

outputs.name: risk-rating
outputs.desc: Customer risk rating (low, medium, high)

outputs.name: risk-factors
outputs.desc: Factors contributing to the risk rating

process: Evaluate geographic risk based on country of residence and nationality.
Assess the customer type and expected transaction profile.
Weigh screening hits and adverse media findings.
Assign the composite risk rating.

steps.description: Conduct enhanced due diligence for high-risk customers and produce the KYC record.

outputs.name: edd-report
outputs.desc: Enhanced due diligence findings and recommendation

outputs.name: kyc-record
outputs.desc: Complete KYC record with all documentation and decisions

process: For high-risk customers, collect additional information (source of wealth, source of funds, business purpose).
Conduct deeper background research and reference checks.
Document the due diligence findings and make the accept or decline recommendation.
Compile the complete KYC record for the compliance file.

description: Screen transactions and parties against international sanctions lists.

steps.description: Collect party details for sanctions screening.

inputs.name: party-details
inputs.desc: Name, address, country, and identifiers of the party

inputs.name: transaction-context
inputs.desc: Description of the transaction or relationship

outputs.name: screening-request
outputs.desc: Formatted screening request with all party identifiers

outputs.name: applicable-lists
outputs.desc: Sanctions lists applicable based on jurisdiction

process: Collect all known identifiers (names, aliases, addresses, dates of birth, entity numbers).
Determine which sanctions lists apply based on the jurisdictions involved.
Format the screening request with all identifiers and variations.
Submit for screening.

steps.description: Screen against OFAC, EU, UN, and other applicable sanctions lists.

outputs.name: screening-results
outputs.desc: Raw screening results with match scores

outputs.name: potential-matches
outputs.desc: Potential matches requiring human review

process: Run the screening request against each applicable sanctions list.
Apply fuzzy matching to account for name variations and transliterations.
Score each potential match by confidence level.
Separate clear negatives from potential matches.

steps.description: Review potential matches, escalate confirmed hits, and document the screening decision.

outputs.name: screening-decision
outputs.desc: Final decision (cleared, blocked, escalated) for each match

outputs.name: screening-record
outputs.desc: Complete screening record with rationale

process: Review each potential match against available identifying information.
Determine whether the match is a true positive, false positive, or inconclusive.
Escalate confirmed hits to the compliance officer and block the transaction.
Document the decision rationale for the screening record.

description: Manage corporate policies from drafting through retirement.

steps.description: Draft a corporate policy based on regulatory and business requirements.

inputs.name: policy-topic
inputs.desc: Subject area and purpose of the policy

outputs.name: policy-draft
outputs.desc: Draft policy document

outputs.name: policy-metadata
outputs.desc: Metadata including owner, version, effective date, and review schedule

process: Define the policy scope, purpose, and applicability.
Write the policy statements aligned to regulatory requirements.
Include definitions, roles, responsibilities, and exceptions.
Set the version number and effective date.

steps.description: Route the policy for review and approval by stakeholders.

outputs.name: approved-policy
outputs.desc: Approved policy with sign-off records

outputs.name: review-comments
outputs.desc: Comments and changes from reviewers

process: Identify the required reviewers (legal, compliance, business owners).
Distribute for review with a deadline.
Collect and incorporate feedback.
Obtain final approval from the policy owner.

steps.description: Publish the policy, communicate to employees, and track acknowledgment.

outputs.name: publication-record
outputs.desc: Record of publication and distribution

outputs.name: acknowledgment-tracker
outputs.desc: Tracker of employee acknowledgments

process: Publish the policy to the central policy repository.
Notify affected employees with a summary and link.
Track acknowledgments and follow up on non-responses.
Archive the prior version.

steps.description: Schedule periodic reviews and retire superseded policies.

outputs.name: review-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule for periodic policy reviews

outputs.name: policy-lifecycle-record
outputs.desc: Complete lifecycle record of the policy

process: Set the next review date based on the policy review schedule.
Monitor for regulatory changes that trigger an early review.
Retire superseded policies and update cross-references.
Maintain the policy lifecycle record.

description: Monitor, assess, and implement regulatory changes affecting the organization.

steps.description: Monitor regulatory sources for new or amended rules.

inputs.name: regulatory-scope
inputs.desc: Industries, jurisdictions, and regulatory bodies to monitor

inputs.name: current-obligations
inputs.desc: Existing regulatory obligations and compliance status

outputs.name: change-alerts
outputs.desc: New regulatory changes identified

outputs.name: change-summaries
outputs.desc: Summary of each change with effective dates

process: Subscribe to regulatory feeds and publications for each jurisdiction.
Review new rules, amendments, and guidance documents.
Summarize each change with its scope, effective date, and affected areas.
Distribute change alerts to the compliance team.

steps.description: Assess the impact of regulatory changes on current operations.

outputs.name: impact-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of operational, process, and system impacts

outputs.name: gap-analysis
outputs.desc: Gaps between current state and new requirements

process: Map each regulatory change to affected processes and controls.
Assess the magnitude of required changes (minor update vs major overhaul).
Identify gaps between current practices and new requirements.
Prioritize changes by effective date and risk.

steps.description: Plan and implement changes to meet new regulatory requirements.

outputs.name: implementation-plan
outputs.desc: Plan with tasks, owners, and deadlines

outputs.name: change-evidence
outputs.desc: Evidence of implemented changes

process: Create the implementation plan with tasks, owners, and deadlines.
Execute the changes (policy updates, process changes, system modifications, training).
Collect evidence that each change was implemented.
Validate compliance through testing or review.

steps.description: Communicate regulatory changes to affected teams and update the compliance record.

outputs.name: communication-record
outputs.desc: Record of communications to affected teams

outputs.name: regulatory-change-record
outputs.desc: Complete record of the regulatory change lifecycle

process: Notify affected teams of the changes and new requirements.
Update training materials and procedures.
File the regulatory change record with all evidence.
Schedule follow-up monitoring.

description: Conduct due diligence on a third party before entering a business relationship.

steps.description: Define the risk criteria and information requirements for due diligence.

inputs.name: third-party-name
inputs.desc: Name and description of the third party

inputs.name: relationship-type
inputs.desc: Type of relationship (vendor, partner, agent, customer)

outputs.name: risk-criteria
outputs.desc: Risk criteria tailored to the relationship type

outputs.name: information-request
outputs.desc: List of information and documents to collect

process: Determine the risk tier based on relationship type and access to data or systems.
Define the due diligence criteria (financial, legal, operational, security, reputational).
Build the information request list.
Set the timeline for collection and review.

steps.description: Screen the third party for sanctions, adverse media, and regulatory issues.

outputs.name: screening-results
outputs.desc: Sanctions, PEP, adverse media, and litigation screening results

outputs.name: red-flag-summary
outputs.desc: Summary of any red flags identified

process: Screen against sanctions and PEP lists.
Search for adverse media, litigation, and regulatory actions.
Review corporate registry filings and ownership structure.
Summarize any red flags.

steps.description: Assess the financial stability and data security practices of the third party.

outputs.name: financial-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of financial health and stability

outputs.name: security-assessment
outputs.desc: Assessment of data security and privacy practices

process: Review financial statements and credit reports.
Assess data security certifications (SOC 2, ISO 27001) and practices.
Evaluate business continuity and insurance coverage.
Rate the overall financial and security posture.

steps.description: Make the risk-based approval decision and produce the due diligence report.

outputs.name: approval-decision
outputs.desc: Approve, approve with conditions, or decline

outputs.name: due-diligence-report
outputs.desc: Complete due diligence report

process: Weigh all findings against the risk criteria.
Make the approval decision (approve, approve with conditions, decline).
Document any conditions or mitigating controls required.
Compile the due diligence report for the compliance file.

description: Conduct a business impact analysis to identify critical processes and set recovery priorities.

steps.description: Identify critical business processes and their dependencies.

outputs.name: critical-processes
outputs.desc: List of critical business processes ranked by importance

outputs.name: dependency-map
outputs.desc: Dependencies between processes, systems, and third parties

process: Survey business units to identify their key processes.
Rank processes by revenue impact, regulatory obligation, and customer impact.
Map dependencies (IT systems, third parties, personnel, facilities).
Identify single points of failure.

steps.description: Assess the impact of disruption for each critical process.

outputs.name: impact-profiles
outputs.desc: Financial, operational, reputational, and regulatory impact over time for each process

outputs.name: maximum-tolerable-downtime
outputs.desc: Maximum tolerable downtime for each critical process

process: For each critical process, estimate the financial impact of disruption over time (1 hour, 4 hours, 1 day, 1 week).
Assess operational, reputational, and regulatory impacts.
Determine the maximum tolerable downtime.
Identify the recovery time objective and recovery point objective.

steps.description: Set recovery priorities and produce the BIA report.

outputs.name: recovery-priorities
outputs.desc: Prioritized list of processes for recovery

outputs.name: bia-report
outputs.desc: Complete business impact analysis report

process: Rank processes by recovery priority based on impact and tolerable downtime.
Identify the minimum resources needed to restore each process.
Define recovery strategies for each tier.
Compile the BIA report with recommendations.

description: Investigate a report received through the ethics hotline.

steps.description: Receive and log the ethics hotline report and assess severity.

inputs.name: report-details
inputs.desc: Details of the ethics report (allegation, parties involved, dates)

outputs.name: case-record
outputs.desc: Logged case with case number and initial assessment

outputs.name: severity-rating
outputs.desc: Severity rating and recommended investigation scope

process: Log the report with a unique case number.
Assess the severity and urgency of the allegation.
Determine whether immediate protective action is needed.
Assign a priority and recommended investigation scope.

steps.description: Interview witnesses, collect evidence, and analyze findings.

outputs.name: interview-summaries
outputs.desc: Summaries of all interviews conducted

outputs.name: evidence-collection
outputs.desc: Documentary and digital evidence collected

process: Interview the reporter (if available), the respondent, and witnesses.
Collect relevant documents, emails, and system logs.
Maintain confidentiality and document the chain of custody.
Identify patterns and corroborating evidence.

steps.description: Analyze findings, determine the outcome, and recommend corrective actions.

outputs.name: investigation-findings
outputs.desc: Findings with substantiated or unsubstantiated determination

outputs.name: investigation-report
outputs.desc: Complete investigation report with recommended actions

process: Analyze the evidence against the allegation.
Determine whether the allegation is substantiated, unsubstantiated, or inconclusive.
Recommend corrective or disciplinary actions.
Compile the investigation report and close the case.

description: Manage ongoing vendor risk through monitoring, reassessment, and exit planning.

steps.description: Maintain the vendor inventory with risk tiers.

outputs.name: tiered-vendor-inventory
outputs.desc: Vendor inventory with risk tiers (critical, high, medium, low)

outputs.name: reassessment-schedule
outputs.desc: Schedule for periodic reassessments by tier

process: Inventory all active vendors with their services and data access.
Assign each vendor to a risk tier based on criticality and data sensitivity.
Set the reassessment frequency by tier (critical: annual, high: biannual, medium/low: triennial).
Update the inventory with current contract and contact information.

steps.description: Conduct periodic vendor reassessments based on the schedule.

outputs.name: reassessment-results
outputs.desc: Results of each vendor reassessment

outputs.name: risk-changes
outputs.desc: Vendors with changed risk profiles

process: Identify vendors due for reassessment.
Collect updated information (financials, certifications, incident history).
Reassess against the risk criteria.
Flag vendors with material changes in risk profile.

steps.description: Monitor vendors for adverse events and enforce contractual obligations.

outputs.name: monitoring-alerts
outputs.desc: Alerts for adverse vendor events

outputs.name: compliance-status
outputs.desc: Vendor compliance status against contractual obligations

process: Monitor for vendor data breaches, financial distress, and regulatory actions.
Track vendor compliance with contractual SLAs and security requirements.
Issue alerts for material events requiring action.
Document findings in the vendor risk record.

steps.description: Plan and execute vendor exits when needed.

outputs.name: exit-plan
outputs.desc: Plan for transitioning away from the vendor

outputs.name: vendor-risk-report
outputs.desc: Complete vendor risk management report

process: For vendors requiring exit, identify replacement options.
Plan the data migration and service transition.
Execute the contractual termination process.
Compile the vendor risk management report.
